findings.issue: The Task 1 table labels March and September values as numbers of items digitised, but the recorded-interviews row reports 25 and 48 hours of audio. This leaves the units inconsistent and makes cross-row comparisons ambiguous.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a neutral amount header and state units per row (items for photographs and letters, pages for newspapers, hours of audio for interviews), or convert all categories to a common unit if appropriate.
